Application Security

Instrumentation dynamique du code

The process of inserting monitoring hooks or logic into running code to analyze application behavior, detect anomalies, or identify security weaknesses at runtime.

What is Instrumentation dynamique du code?

In this glossary, Instrumentation dynamique du code refers to: The process of inserting monitoring hooks or logic into running code to analyze application behavior, detect anomalies, or identify security weaknesses at runtime.
